other_conditions: Must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law
Must not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF), National Pension System (NPS) or Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)
Must not be an income tax payer
Must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab
Must have complete or partial disability
Must not possess Health Cards issued under the Bhagat Puran Singh Sehat Bima Yojna
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹4,00,000 as ex-gratia compensation for complete or partial disability, calculated at ₹4,000 per 1% disability.
